source.board_memo: PPS 'Rightsizing Update: Scenario Release' memo, Oct 5 2026 (meub/pps-data data/raw/pps_rightsizing_board_2026-10-06/)
source.family_guides: Per-school Family Guides via https://www.pps.net/about/portland-public-schools-information/rightsize/how-could-your-school-be-impacted (Awesome Table -> Google Drive PDFs), saved in raw/family_guides/
source.maps: Attendance boundary map PDFs (Status Quo/A/B x K-5, 6-8, 9-12; School Year 2027-28) from BoardBook org 915 files 14505795-14505805; Scenario A 6-8 also from the user's Downloads. Digitized from vector paths (raw/scenario_maps/)

digitization_qa.georeference: affine PDF->EPSG:2913 fitted on Status-Quo 6-8 lines vs current lines (ICP)
digitization_qa.status_quo_6_8_block_agreement: 98.7% (all 100 disagreements = Rigler K-5 area drawn in Roseway Heights on the 2027-28 SQ map vs Beaumont in the City/PPS 2023-24 layer)
digitization_qa.status_quo_9_12: matches current except dual-assignment zones, which the 2027-28 map shows as Jefferson-only

status_quo_2027_28.note: PPS's own 'No Change' map for 2027-28: same lines as today except Jefferson HS dual-assignment zones become Jefferson (phase-in) and the Rigler K-5 area is shown feeding Roseway Heights.

receivers.group: neighborhood, south of Burnside / north of Hawthorne (~50%)

k8_conversions_and_grade_changes.to: K-5 neighborhood; focus discontinued, no new lottery transfers (current lottery students may stay through grade 5)
K-5 (keeps neighborhood area and Creative Science focus)
k8_conversions_and_grade_changes.grades_6_8_to: Harrison Park (or return to neighborhood middle school)

k8_conversions_and_grade_changes.to: K-5 regional Spanish DLI only; neighborhood K-5 -> Rosa Parks

k8_conversions_and_grade_changes.note: Bybee Lake Shelter area moves Faubion -> Astor (K-8) and Jefferson -> Roosevelt

k8_conversions_and_grade_changes.to: K-8 alternative (9-12 to neighborhood HS / other options; Odyssey co-locates)

dli_and_program_moves.to: Cesar Chavez (K-5 regional Spanish DLI hub)
Lent (whole-school Spanish DLI; Lent's neighborhood area -> Kelly)
Rigler (becomes regional Spanish DLI school; Rigler's non-DLI neighborhood area -> Scott)
Vestal (6-8 Vietnamese stays at Roseway Heights)

focus_option_changes: Buckman arts focus closes with the building
Odyssey moves to MLC site (East Sylvan building closes)
Winterhaven, da Vinci, ACCESS, Richmond, Benson unchanged
middle_school_changes: Beaumont: + Beverly Cleary 6-8 (incl. former Irvington area, which leaves Tubman); Spanish DLI -> Roseway Heights
Mt Tabor: + Laurelhurst 6-8
Hosford: + Sunnyside 6-8 + Llewellyn area (from Sellwood) [+ Duniway-west-of-McLoughlin area in A]
Lane (Brentwood): + Duniway and Lewis areas (from Sellwood); Kelly neighborhood 6-8 -> Harrison Park; Russian DLI stays
Harrison Park: + Lent and Kelly areas; Atkinson area -> Kellogg; Bridger 6-8 (from K-8); Mandarin DLI stays
Kellogg: + Atkinson and Creston areas; Lent area -> Harrison Park; all SE Spanish DLI 6-8 stays at Kellogg
Tubman: + Vernon 6-8; Irvington area -> Beaumont
Ockley Green: + Faubion 6-8; Peninsula area -> George; Spanish DLI -> George; all Ockley Green feeds Jefferson
George: + Cesar Chavez 6-8, Peninsula area, Spanish DLI from Ockley Green and Chavez (regional 6-8 Spanish DLI)
Gray: + Maplewood area (from Jackson); Jackson loses Maplewood area
Roseway Heights: + Spanish DLI from Beaumont; keeps Vietnamese DLI
Sellwood: closes (2028)
high_school_changes: Cleveland: + Sunnyside area (from Franklin); remaining Woodmere/Whitman pieces -> Franklin
Franklin: + expanded Whitman area (former Whitman+Woodmere); Sunnyside area -> Cleveland; small Vestal piece -> McDaniel
McDaniel: + small part of Vestal area (from Franklin)
Roosevelt: + Skyline area; + Bybee Lake Shelter area (from Jefferson)
Jefferson: own neighborhood boundary already phasing in under Status Quo (dual assignment ending); minor Bybee Lake Shelter change
MLC 9-12 program closes; students to neighborhood HS (not counted as a closure)
Grant, Ida B. Wells, Benson: no change
